items.description: Fix hasSubstitution double-quote tracking in internal/perm/rules.go: the a710b75 rewrite dropped double-quote tracking, so `git "log 'x $(cmd) y'"` under-detects live command substitution and an allow rule can match a substitution-bearing command (WR-02 violation, live-verified 2026-09-03, recorded in STATE.md Blockers/Concerns). Restore double-quote tracking in the scanner and pin the live case plus sibling quote-nesting cases with table-driven tests in internal/perm; acceptance: an allow rule must never match a substitution-bearing command, mise ci green.

Diagnose and fix the TestPermissionsE2E regression in internal/acpserve introduced by Phase 23 commit 40b2bbc (steering ingress; passes at 721c7bc, fails at dbbb5d0 — operator-bisected in an isolated worktree, WINDOWS #22). Reproduce at master (documented as failing under -race), root-cause the offending hunk, fix production or the test per the root cause, then remove the TestPermissionsE2E entry from the nightly test skip list in .github/workflows/nightly-parity.yml (WINDOWS #27).

Fix the TestRescanConcurrency data race in internal/runtime/rescan_test.go (spawnMCP reading vs installRegistry writing, pre-existing before 22-04, WINDOWS #21) following the ab7956b fakeLearned mutex-guard precedent, then remove the TestRescanConcurrency entry from the nightly test skip list in .github/workflows/nightly-parity.yml (WINDOWS #27).

Broken Windows ledger bookkeeping in .planning/WINDOWS.md: mark rows #23 and #24 fixed (discharged by the operator Phase-23 UAT 2/2 on 2026-09-20, per STATE.md Phase 23 entry and 23-UAT evidence), record the stdout-discipline observation from 23-UAT as fixed by commit ed83044 (non-reproducing on release code, pipeGitRun regression test added), and refresh open_count accordingly.
